title: fix(runtime)!: the legacy /automation/trigger POST past three segments is no route
body:
Fixes #32026

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -nE "automation/trigger/|trigger/:|/trigger/[a-z_]+/" -- 'content/docs/**' 'skills/**'` finds two hits, and neither teaches a path deeper than the served shapes: `content/docs/api/plugin-endpoints.mdx:52` names the legacy alias `/automation/trigger/:name` (two segments, still served), and `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx:312` names `POST /trigger/:name` (release-owned, two segments). Nothing in `skills/**` names the legacy door.

The narrowing (claim amendment 6770142344): a path that ran a flow is declined, so **one contract-review-tier review is owed before the queue**.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:旧的 `POST /api/v1/automation/trigger/...` 只服务两种形状(`trigger/:name` 与 `trigger/:ns/:name`),更深的 `POST` 一律当作无此路由拒绝,什么也不跑。
- 为什么改:catch-all 宿主(`createHonoApp`)上四段及以上的路径会跑一个 flow 并忽略尾部;挂载宿主上 `POST /automation/trigger/runs/:runId/cancel` 会跑名为 `runs` 的 flow。与 `/actions` 的段数上限同类。
- 风险与回滚:风险是外部调用方若曾向旧入口发送超过三段的路径,会从「跑了 flow」变成 404;首方调用方计数为 0。回滚即还原 `automation.ts` 中的一行判断。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`(旧 trigger 分支上方的拒绝判断,`parts.length >= 3`);`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-addressed-route.test.ts`(新增 pin);`.changeset/32026-legacy-trigger-arity.md`(BREAKING 说明)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/automation-addressed-route.test.ts`,预期 35 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(落地前需一次契约复审档复核)。

## What changes

The legacy trigger arm in `handleAutomationRequest` serves exactly two shapes: `POST trigger/:name` (bare) and `POST trigger/:ns/:name` (addressed, which the address read strips to the bare two parts). Part (c) of G1 already declined a three-part `POST` that is no address. This PR widens that same decline from `parts.length === 3` to `parts.length >= 3`, so every `POST` deeper than the served shapes is declined as an unserved shape (`{ handled: false }`) and runs nothing:

- catch-all host (`createHonoApp`): the host's own `404`, where the domain ran the flow named by the segment after `trigger` and ignored the tail;
- mounted host (the dispatcher plugin): the dispatcher's no-route `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` for each deep `POST` mount a `trigger/...` path matches by its parameters (`/automation/:name/runs/:runId/cancel|resume|restore-suspension` with `:name` = `trigger`, and the addressed `/automation/:ns/:name/runs/:runId/...` with `:ns` = `trigger`). Before, these ran the flow `runs` (or `:ns`). Any other deep path stays the transport's `404`, as before.

The mechanism and its wording are part (b)'s for `/actions` (`ca3629fe`, "A longer path is no route, and is declined (`handled: false`), so the dispatcher answers its no-route `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` on every host"), reused through part (c)'s existing decline line rather than a second one.

Other verbs at any depth are untouched: they belong to a flow named `trigger` (`GET /automation/trigger/runs/:runId` answers its run; `PUT`/`GET` on a four-segment run-door shape answers the domain's `405` with `Allow: POST`). Both are pinned as CONTROLs.

### The ruling this derives from

Contract review 6754801375 on PR #32001 (`Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`), section ③ Boundary flags:

> The legacy trigger past three segments stays unbounded: accepted as left, with the follow-up card. It is base behaviour, and no addressed shape is that deep. The card should also carry `POST trigger/runs/:runId/resume` running the flow `runs`.

The delta review 6755708575 (PASS), ③: "The legacy trigger arm past three segments is left as it is on `main`, and the seat files a follow-up card." This PR is that card. The `POST trigger/runs/:runId/resume` case the review names is pinned: it is declined and runs nothing.

### Ruling comments beside the edit (kept intact)

The decline sits under part (c)'s comment, which this PR does not edit: "[ADR-0150 D5, child G1] `trigger/:x/:y` is the addressed legacy trigger or no route: ... Only `POST` is that arm's: another verb is the flow `trigger`'s (`GET trigger/runs/:runId`). Declined — behind every gate above, so none becomes narrower than its route — as `/actions` declines a path past its arity." A new paragraph below it records the bound.

One sentence of the `isRunLifecycleWrite` docblock was made false by this change, and is corrected: "for a flow literally named `runs` the path `/automation/trigger/runs/x/cancel` RUNS that flow" now reads that the path "is that door's: past its two-part bound, so the door declines it and it runs nothing (before the bound it RAN that flow)". The ⛔ rule itself is unchanged: the exclusion of `parts[0] === 'trigger'`, and why gating or dispatching a cancel from it is wrong. Every other `ruling` / `maintainer` / ⛔ comment in the file is byte-identical.

### First-party count: 0

`git grep -nE "automation/trigger/" -- 'packages/client*' 'ui/**' 'packages/cli/**'` (excluding `*.md`/`*.mdx`) finds one hit: `packages/client/src/client.test.ts:1499`, `.../automation/trigger/my_flow`, two segments. The SDK's `client.automation.trigger()` builds `${route}/trigger/${triggerName}`: two segments for a flow machine name. `ui/**`, `packages/cli/**`, `packages/client-react/**`, `packages/qa/**` and `examples/**` have no caller of the legacy door.

## Tests

- `automation-addressed-route.test.ts` (driven through the real `HttpDispatcher`):
  - a bare call past the bound is declined at four, five and the run-door depths (`trigger/send_digest/a/b`, `trigger/send_digest/a/b/c`, `trigger/runs/r1/cancel|resume|restore-suspension`), and `execute` is never called;
  - an addressed call past the bound is declined (`trigger/crm/send_digest/extra`, `trigger/_env/ping/extra`, `trigger/crm/runs/r1/resume`), and nothing runs;
  - on the catch-all seam (`dispatcher.dispatch()`, what `createHonoApp` hands every path), the deep paths are declined, and nothing runs;
  - CONTROL: the same seam serves the bare and addressed two-/three-segment calls (200, both executed);
  - CONTROL: another verb at three segments (`GET trigger/runs/r1`) and at four (`PUT trigger/runs/r1/resume`, `GET trigger/runs/r1/cancel`, each `405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, `Allow: POST`) is the flow `trigger`'s.
- `automation-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts` (real Hono socket, both prefixes): signed-in `POST .../automation/trigger/runs/r1/cancel` and `.../automation/trigger/crm/runs/r1/resume` answer `404`, `error.code` `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`, `error.httpStatus` `404`, with no flow run; CONTROL: `POST .../automation/trigger/send_digest` answers 200 and runs `send_digest`.
- `automation-run-lifecycle-door.test.ts`: the pin "leaves the legacy execution door alone" asserted that `trigger/runs/run_7/cancel` RAN the flow `runs`. That is the behaviour this PR removes, so the pin now asserts the path is declined (`handled: false`), not a `403`, and neither `execute` nor `cancelRun` is called.

Ablation (one-off, committed fix first): the anchor `parts.length >= 3` was set back to `parts.length === 3` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (mutation landed: anchor 1 to 0, blob `b048d517` to `c8ae4d3b`). 8 of 102 tests went red: the bare, addressed and catch-all pins, the four socket pins and the flipped lifecycle pin. Every CONTROL stayed green. The file was restored (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty).

## Acceptance notes

- The card's phrase "declined as an unserved shape before any gate runs anything" was measured rather than re-placed. Between the address read and the legacy arm, no gate reads a `trigger/...` `POST`: each one excludes `parts[0] === 'trigger'` (authoring, toggle, clone, activation, run lifecycle), reads `GET` only (run read), or reads another first segment (connector doors), and the address admission's `bareByNameItem` returns nothing for `trigger` past two parts. Only the domain-wide anonymous floor (`401`) and the automation service probe (`501`) answer ahead of the decline, as for every path of the domain, and as for part (c)'s three-part decline. The decline stays where part (c) placed it, inside the arm (the claim's file surface).
- The dispatch's mechanism note cited `automation.ts:542` ("the absence of any depth bound are that arm's") as the legacy arm's missing bound. That line is about the toggle predicate (`isFlowEnablementWrite`, commit 266436a7f), not the legacy trigger. The premise holds on its own: the legacy arm read `if (parts[0] === 'trigger' && parts[1] && m === 'POST')` with no depth bound, and the ablation run shows a deep `POST` ran a flow on both hosts.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` follows the claim amendment 6770142344, which corrected the claim's `Clause-②: no` to the card's own line. The changeset carries the same line, the `**BREAKING**` banner and its ADR-0087 marker.

## Verification

The local subset ran on the merged head (`origin/main` merged once at 5cd8715f; later commits are one test import and the changeset's arm). CI runs the full farm.

<details>
<summary>Runtime package: test and typecheck (head 5cd8715f, under the verify lock)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/runtime^...' build`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 577 passed (577), Tests 9610 passed and 19 skipped (9629).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0.
- Lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Derived gate families (dispatch-gates --commands, head 5cd8715f, 70 commands)</summary>

- 68 exit 0.
- `pnpm check:test-source-alias` was red on the edited `automation-run-lifecycle-door.test.ts`: its reach loads `@objectstack/metadata` inside a clocked window. Fixed with a module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata';` (e69015b1). Rerun: exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED, exit 3 for an unmet prerequisite: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (shallow clone; its positive control is pinned to a commit) and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs every workspace package's `dist/`). Both run in CI.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 70 derived, 68 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- After the arm fix (a7c8cadd), `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exit 0 (`[BREAKING] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`), `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0, `check-empty-changeset` exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 4 changed `.ts` files: exit 0. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Ablation (one-off)</summary>

Committed fix first. `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` set `parts.length >= 3` back to `parts.length === 3` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `b048d517` to `c8ae4d3b`). The three touched files then ran 8 failed and 94 passed of 102. The 8: the bare, addressed and catch-all pins, the four socket `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` pins and the flipped lifecycle pin. Every CONTROL stayed green. Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

The dogfood battery (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm) runs once on the final head. Its reading is in the `os-dev-report` comment on #32026.
